engineering.title: Optimize Array Processing
engineering.description:
Given an array of integers, write a function that finds the maximum subarray sum using Kadane's algorithm.

Requirements:
- Provide time and space complexity analysis
- Handle edge cases (empty array, all negative numbers, etc.)
- Include test cases with your solution
